input_contract.deduplication: SHA-256 of normalized title, then normalized URL
input_contract.information_set_available: 00:00 UTC on the following calendar day
input_contract.selection: domain round-robin, chronological within domain, maximum 48 headlines

model_contract.parse_or_request_failure: record error; no score; flat decision

reliability_stabilization.selection_basis: predeclared from reliability evidence before consensus trading results

action_policy.long_when: both component runs have score >= 0.30 and confidence >= 0.70
action_policy.threshold_selection: predeclared before outcome backtest; not return-optimized

operational_safety.sensor_failure: fail closed; do not start or continue sustained compute
operational_safety.at_ceiling: stop compute producer, preserve atomic checkpoint, unload local model and restore Balanced
operational_safety.runtime_preference: overnight execution is acceptable; thermal safety takes priority over speed

unresolved_before_freeze: current consensus calibration intervals span zero and do not establish a reliable predictive edge
obtain untouched evidence under a fully frozen model, prompt, source snapshot and dual-run action policy before live consideration
treat any model or prompt change as a new predeclared development cycle
